build_biencoder_from_config: build a BERT biencoder with question and context encoders from a DPR config object
build_reader_from_config: build a BERT reader model with encoder and optimizer from a DPR config object
create_bert_tensorizer: create a BertTensorizer that converts text to tokenized tensors using a BERT tokenizer
create_roberta_tensorizer: create a RobertaTensorizer that converts text to tokenized tensors using a RoBERTa tokenizer
init_hf_bert_encoder: initialize a HuggingFace BERT encoder with optional projection layer and dropout settings
